meta.title: Buyer extends the ongoing Knockout round
gaps: Identify and click the plus button (+) in the live Knockout round controls.
Select additional time from the Knockout round extension control.
Verify that the ongoing Knockout round timer shows the added time.
Ensure the opened existing event is specifically a live Knockout auction.
